南鯤鯓代天府與井仔腳鹽田Nankunshen Temple & Jingzijiao Salt Fields

歡迎來到南鯤鯓代天府，台灣王爺信仰的總廟，分靈廟超過兩萬座。三百多年前，一艘載著五位王爺的王船，漂到了鯤鯓沙洲上。囝仔公插下銅針，五王埋下銅錢。土地公挖開一看，銅針正好插在銅錢的方孔裡。大戰數月後，觀音佛祖、媽祖與保生大帝出面調解：五王蓋大廟，囝仔公有小廟。往北二十分鐘是井仔腳，1818 年開闢，是台灣現存最古老的鹽田。鹽田底部鋪滿碎瓦片，夕陽時，鹽田變成一片片彩色玻璃。

Welcome to Nankunshen Daitian Temple, the headquarters of Taiwan's Wangye faith, with more than twenty thousand branch temples. Over three hundred years ago, a spirit boat carrying five royal lords drifted onto a whale-back sandbar. The boy god had planted a needle, and the five lords had buried a coin. When the Earth God dug, the needle stood right in the coin's square hole. After months of battle, Guanyin, Mazu and Baosheng Dadi made peace: the lords built the big temple, and the boy got his small one. Twenty minutes north is Jingzaijiao, Taiwan's oldest surviving salt field, laid out in 1818. Its floors are paved with tile shards. At sunset, the ponds turn to colored glass. Let's explore!

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

南鯤鯓代天府是台灣王爺信仰的總廟，分靈廟超過兩萬座，進香期是國家指定的民俗。往北不遠的井仔腳，是台灣現存最古老的鹽田，夕陽時鹽田倒映天空。

Nankunshen Daitian Temple is the head temple of Taiwan's Wangye faith, with more than twenty thousand branch temples. Nearby, the Jingzijiao salt fields are the oldest surviving salt pans in Taiwan and glow at sunset.

  1. 三百多年前 Over 300 years ago（相傳 legend）一艘載著五位王爺的王船漂到鯤鯓沙洲，傳說與當地的囝仔公爭地，最後各有一廟。Legend says a king boat with five Wangye gods drifted ashore, and after a dispute with the local boy god, each received a temple.
  2. 1818井仔腳鹽田開闢。The Jingzijiao salt fields are opened.
  3. 今天 Today進香期為國家指定民俗；鹽田仍以人工耙鹽。Its pilgrimage season is a national folk heritage, and salt is still raked by hand.

認識景點

About the place

代天府：南鯤鯓代天府是台南最宏偉的廟宇。 王爺、千歲：王爺是奉天命巡狩人間的神明。 巡狩：王爺巡狩人間，驅除瘟疫與邪惡。 瘟疫：人們向王爺祈求遠離瘟疫。

Daitian Temple: Nankunshen Daitian Temple is the grandest temple in Tainan. royal lord: Royal lords are sent by Heaven to patrol the human world. patrol: The royal lords patrol the world to sweep away plague and evil. plague: People prayed to the royal lords to keep plague away.

王船：從福建放流，漂到哪裡，就在哪裡建廟。 鯤鯓：「鯤鯓」的意思是像鯨魚背的沙洲。 五府千歲：是李、池、吳、朱、范五位王爺。 囝仔公：一位牧童在這塊地上成神，人們叫他囝仔公（萬善爺），是當地的守護神。

spirit boat: Spirit boats were set adrift from Fujian. Where one landed, a temple rose. whale-back sandbar: Kunshen means a sandbar shaped like a whale's back. five royal lords: The five lords are Li, Chi, Wu, Zhu, and Fan. Boy Lord: A shepherd boy became a god on this land. People call him the Boy Lord, the local guardian god.

銅針與銅錢：囝仔公的銅針正好插在五王銅錢的方孔裡，誰也不讓誰。 土地公（福德正神）：雙方請土地公到場挖地，驗證誰的憑證在先。 陰兵：與天兵在沙丘上大戰。 傷痕：三王吳府千歲額頭受傷，傷痕至今無人修得好。

needle and coin: The boy god's needle stood right in the five lords' coin, so neither side would give way. Earth God: Both sides asked the Earth God to dig and check their proof. ghost soldiers: Ghost soldiers fought heavenly troops over the dunes. scar: The third lord, Wu, was wounded on the forehead, and the scar was never repaired.

觀音佛祖：赤山巖觀音佛祖與媽祖、保生大帝出面，為五王與囝仔公調解。 萬善堂（小廟）：囝仔公的小廟是萬善堂。大廟、小廟都要拜。 進香：南鯤鯓的進香期是國家指定的民俗。 分靈廟：超過兩萬座分靈廟的香火源自這裡。

Guanyin: of Chishan Temple, with Mazu and Baosheng Dadi, made peace between the five lords and the boy god. Wanshan Hall: The boy god's small temple is Wanshan Hall. Honor the big temple, and the small one too. pilgrimage: Its pilgrimage seasons are a national folk custom. branch temple: More than twenty thousand branch temples trace their incense here.

黃金聖旨牌：凌霄寶殿有一面用一萬多兩黃金打造的聖旨牌。 瓦盤鹽田：鹽田底部鋪滿碎瓦，曬出的鹽潔白乾淨。 碎瓦片：泥土會混進鹽裡，所以鹽田底部鋪上碎瓦。 鹵水：工人至今仍用手耙鹵水。

gold tablet: The Lingxiao Hall has a decree tablet made from over ten thousand taels of gold. tile-paved salt field: The salt beds are paved with tile shards, so the salt comes up white and clean. tile shard: Mud gets into salt, so the beds were paved with broken tiles. brine: Workers still rake the brine by hand.

耙子：拿起耙子，堆一座自己的小鹽山。 鹽堆：一座座白色小鹽堆在陽光下曬乾。 魔幻時刻：夕陽的魔幻時刻，鹽田倒映著天空。

rake: Pick up a rake and pile your own little salt mountain. salt cone: Little white salt cones dry in the sun. golden hour: At golden hour, the ponds mirror the sky.

實景照片

Photos on site

井仔腳瓦盤鹽田 Jingzaijiao Salt Fields

這是北門區的井仔腳瓦盤鹽田，從 1818 年就在這裡，是台灣現存最古老的瓦盤鹽田。鹽田底部鋪著碎瓦片，白色的鹽堆成一座座小鹽山；夕陽下，池水像鏡子一樣倒映天空。

These are the Jingzaijiao Tile-Paved Salt Fields in Beimen. Here since 1818, they are Taiwan's oldest tile-paved salt fields. Their floors are paved with broken pottery tiles, white salt is piled into little cones, and at sunset the water mirrors the sky.

代天府的庭園一隅 A corner of the temple garden

南鯤鯓代天府的園區很大，除了廟殿，還有中式庭園：橘紅屋瓦的長廊掛著一排紅燈籠，屋簷下的山牆畫著藍白圖案；旁邊的假山流下小瀑布，注入池塘，四周種滿花木，很適合拜拜後散步休息。

The grounds of Nankunshen Daitian Temple are large. Beyond the temple halls is a Chinese garden. A covered walkway with orange-red roof tiles is hung with red lanterns, and its gables are painted in blue and white. Nearby, a small waterfall tumbles over rocks into a pond, surrounded by flowering trees. It is a pleasant place for a stroll after visiting the temple.
